title: Settings
subtitle: Platform configuration, architecture and system status.

architecture.title: Platform architecture
architecture.hint: Hover over the components to follow the data flow paths.

gateway.title: API Gateway
gateway.description: Handles authentication, rate limiting, validation and smart routing to the microservices. Supports REST and GraphQL.

eventbus.title: Event Bus
eventbus.description: Asynchronous pub/sub messaging keeps the modules loosely coupled. When a deal is closed in the CRM, events create the project automatically.

data.title: Data layer
data.description: PostgreSQL for structured data, Neo4j for the knowledge graph relationships and a vector database for semantic search and AI embeddings.

health.error: Could not connect to the system. Check that the backend is running.

notifications.title: Email notifications
notifications.intro: Control which business events send email alerts. Changes are saved automatically.
notifications.masterHint: Master switch — turn it off to stop all email alerts
notifications.summaryOff: All email notifications are turned off
notifications.realtimeBody: In-app notifications are delivered over WebSocket and are always on while you are connected. They cover 13 event types, including workflow status, sales activity, inventory alerts, portal interactions and accounting updates. Use the bell icon in the header to see them.

QuoteAccepted.label: Quotes accepted
QuoteAccepted.desc: When a customer accepts a quote

SalesOrderCreated.label: Sales orders created
SalesOrderCreated.desc: When a new sales order is generated

InventoryLowThresholdDetected.label: Low stock
InventoryLowThresholdDetected.desc: When a product reaches its minimum inventory threshold

InvoiceOverdue.label: Overdue invoices
InvoiceOverdue.desc: When an invoice passes its due date without payment

ai.label: Enable AI recommendations
ai.desc: Show AI suggestions across all modules

projects.label: Create projects automatically from deals
projects.desc: Automatically generate a project when a CRM deal is closed

graph.label: Automatic knowledge graph linking
graph.desc: Automatically detect and link entities in documents
